title: The Lord's Love for Israel

questions.question: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 11:1 (ESV): "When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my son."

questions.question: The more they were called, the more they went away; they kept sacrificing to the what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 11:2 (ESV): "they kept sacrificing to the Baals and burning offerings to idols."

questions.question: I led them with cords of kindness, with the bands of what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 11:4 (ESV): "I led them with cords of kindness, with the bands of love,"

questions.question: How can I give you up, O Ephraim? How can I hand you over, O Israel? How can I make you like whom?
questions.explanation: Hosea 11:8 (ESV): "How can I make you like Admah? How can I treat you like Zeboim?"

questions.question: They shall go after the Lord; he will roar like a what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 11:10 (ESV): "They shall go after the Lord; he will roar like a lion;"

questions.question: Yet it was I who taught Ephraim to walk; I took them up by their what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 11:3 (ESV): "Yet it was I who taught Ephraim to walk; I took them up by their arms,"

questions.question: They shall not return to the land of Egypt, but who shall be their king, because they have refused to return to me?
questions.explanation: Hosea 11:5 (ESV): "but Assyria shall be their king, because they have refused to return to me."

questions.question: My heart recoils within me; my compassion grows what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 11:8 (ESV): "my compassion grows warm and tender."

questions.question: I will not execute my burning anger; I will not again destroy Ephraim; for I am God and not a what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 11:9 (ESV): "for I am God and not a man, the Holy One in your midst,"

questions.question: They shall come trembling like birds from Egypt, and like doves from the land of where?
questions.explanation: Hosea 11:11 (ESV): "and like doves from the land of Assyria,"

questions.question: The sword shall rage against their cities, consume the bars of their gates, and devour them because of their own what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 11:6 (ESV): "and devour them because of their own counsels."

questions.question: My people are bent on turning away from me, and though they call out to the Most High, he shall not raise them up at all.
questions.explanation: Hosea 11:7 (ESV): "My people are bent on turning away from me, and though they call out to the Most High, he shall not raise them up at all."

questions.question: I became to them as one who eases the yoke on their jaws, and I bent down to them and did what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 11:4 (ESV): "and I bent down to them and fed them."

questions.question: Ephraim has surrounded me with what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 11:12 (ESV): "Ephraim has surrounded me with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit,"

questions.question: But Judah still walks with God and is faithful to the what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 11:12 (ESV): "but Judah still walks with God and is faithful to the Holy One."

key_verse_text: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my son.
